claims.claim: 真实测试test_json_decode_compatibility_for_alt_utf_encodings对无效JSON调用r.json()，验证抛公开JSONDecodeError及RequestException兼容。
claims.rationale: 407为真实测试名，414构造替代UTF字节正文、423设encoding=None；424–426是raises和RequestException的isinstance断言。答案没有声称该测试直接使用题设普通文本固定字符串或本轮执行了测试/网络请求，叙述的事实均正确。但正文未解释427行对底层JSONDecodeError的第二个isinstance断言，未覆盖冻结required_points的双重兼容性。允许用该真实lowlevel测试替代test_requests同类测试，不因测试名不同扣分。

verified_evidence.content:
def test_json_decode_compatibility_for_alt_utf_encodings():

    def response_handler(sock):
        consume_socket_content(sock, timeout=0.5)
        sock.send(
            b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n'
            b'Content-Length: 18\r\n\r\n'
            b'\xff\xfe{\x00"\x00K0"\x00=\x00"\x00\xab0"\x00\r\n'
        )

    close_server = threading.Event()
    server = Server(response_handler, wait_to_close_event=close_server)

    with server as (host, port):
        url = f'http://{host}:{port}/'
        r = requests.get(url)
    r.encoding = None
    with pytest.raises(requests.exceptions.JSONDecodeError) as excinfo:
        r.json()
    assert isinstance(excinfo.value, requests.exceptions.RequestException)
    assert isinstance(excinfo.value, JSONDecodeError)
    assert r.text not in str(excinfo.value)
